repaired_payload.caption:
Can paying a small administrative fee unlock a massive celebrity grant?

An elderly man was recently duped of his savings after fraudsters promised ₹1crore in financial aid under actor Vijay Thalapathy's name.

Key takeaways:
• Genuine foundations never demand advance fees to disburse grants
• Scammers exploit celebrity trust to bypass vigilance
• Demands for clearance charges are an immediate sign of fraud

Save this guide and share it with elders in your family.

#FinancialSafety #CyberFraud #VijayThalapathy #ScamAlert

flowchart_data.text: Fraudsters announce a fake ₹1crore aid package invoking celebrity goodwill.
The victim is pressured to deposit processing fees and verification charges.
Repeated payments are collected before the fraudsters disappear completely.

comparison_data.myth: Charitable funds require beneficiaries to pay administrative fees first.
comparison_data.reality: Legitimate charitable foundations disburse funds directly and never demand advance fees.

slides.title: Safety Checklist for Any Grant Offer

checklist_data.item: Unsolicited notification promising large grant amounts
Requirement to pay advance administrative or tax fees
Verification via registered, official public trust offices
